split: h3 (spatial block, H3 res-7 GroupKFold); no time split
units: percent for all error metrics; INR for prices

model_descriptions.B1: hedonic log-linear ridge, attributes + city and locality fixed effects
model_descriptions.B3: LightGBM, attributes + location (lat/lon) + OSM accessibility features
model_descriptions.M+: B3 + spatial kNN smoother on out-of-fold residuals, blend weight fit on the calibration split

seen_locality.note: K-fold grouped by project proxy (city, locality, amenity signature); test localities usually seen in training, projects unseen

coverage_80.method: CQR (LightGBM quantile 10/90) + Mondrian conformal margin per city

latency.hardware: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13450HX (16 logical cores); Windows 11; Python 3.13.9; single uvicorn worker
latency.method: sequential HTTP requests to localhost, client-side wall time, includes SHAP and comparables

dataset: Kaggle ruchi798/housing-prices-in-metropolitan-areas-of-india (CC0: Public Domain); listing asking prices, apartments, snapshot 2020-09-05
ground_truth: listing asking price (proxy), not registered transaction value

data.geocoding: Nominatim, locality centroids; rows whose locality resolved only to a city centroid or not at all are dropped

not_run.M_imagery_model: Sentinel-2 / satellite embeddings were not ingested in the prototype, so model M and the imagery ablation were not run. M+ here is B3 plus the spatial residual layer, without imagery.
not_run.time_split: The open listing dataset carries no listing dates, so no train-on-past / test-on-future split or rolling-origin backtest is possible. Only spatial-block (H3) and random K-fold CV were run.
not_run.time_index_adjustment: No record dates, so RBI RPPI / NHB RESIDEX deflation to a reference date was not applied (ingest_index.py not built).
not_run.asking_to_transaction_adjustment: No paired listing/transaction data to learn a discount. A constant city factor would rescale truth and prediction alike and leave the relative error metrics unchanged, so results are reported against asking price only.
not_run.area_normalisation: The dataset does not state carpet vs built-up vs super built-up, and no record has more than one, so a loading factor could not be learned. Area is used as listed and flagged area_basis=as_listed_unspecified.
not_run.rera_and_circle_rate_features: Brickplot RERA and state circle-rate anchors were not integrated.
not_run.floor_age_features: Floor and building age are absent from the dataset; the API accepts them and reports them under inputs_not_used.
not_run.hyperparameter_search: Optuna tuning not run; fixed LightGBM settings in src/config.py.
not_run.commercial_avm_head_to_head: No vendor or lender AVM outputs available; comparison protocol is specified only.
not_run.policy_gate_in_offline_metrics: Loan amounts are not in the data, so the Rs 75 lakh two-valuer gate is applied in the API and the economics calculator, not in the routing curve.
not_run.osm_relations: OSM multipolygon relations (some large parks and campuses) are not read from the PBF extracts.
